caption: Piazza Unità d'Italia, Trieste
composition: Vast Habsburg seafront square opening onto the Adriatic · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The tourist stands in the vast emptiness of the Piazza Unita d'Italia, its pale paving stretching to the horizon. The clock-towered palazzo fills the center, flanked by grand Habsburg facades on both sides, with a glimpse of the blue Adriatic between the center block and the right wing. The 13:40 sun is high and brilliant under a clear sky, and the square lies completely quiet.
